versions.changelog:
Self-Improving v1.0.2 — Major update with new self-reflection, correction, and memory management files.

- Added core modules: memory tracking, learning, corrections, boundaries, scaling, heartbeat, setup, and operations.
- Removed older references and example guideline files, consolidating knowledge and logic.
- Introduced clear folder/file structure for memory and state organization.
- Clarified install/setup and proactive maintenance flows.
- Improved documentation for how corrections, learning, and self-reflection are handled.

- Major skill overhaul: transforms from "Self-Improving + Proactive Agent" to "Humanizer" for AI writing debiasing.
- Removes all previous self-improving agent logic, guides, and architecture files.
- Adds references for AI writing patterns: banned words, structural issues, and rewrite examples.
- Introduces detailed Chinese/English methods to detect and reduce "AI flavor" in text, focusing on natural, human-like edits.
- Defines a 4-level self-check system (L1–L4) for AI writing detection and quality control.
- New process and checklists for minimal but effective text rewrites, preserving intent and injecting authentic human style.

Self-Improving + Proactive Agent 1.2.16

- Clarified the setup process for proactive follow-up and safer installation behavior.
- Expanded documentation on memory architecture, tiered storage, and promotion/demotion rules.
- Added explicit guidance on when and how to self-reflect and log corrections.
- Updated quick reference, queries, and stats reporting for easier memory management.
- Clearly defined security, scope, and namespace boundaries.
